```python
import pixeltable as pxt

# Get the films table
films = pxt.get_table('films')

# Filter for years > 1990 and select title and revenue columns
query = films.where(films.year > 1990).select(films.title, films.revenue)

# Materialize the results locally
rows = query.collect()

# Display the results
for row in rows:
    print(row)
```
